answer: Make grading itself the vault. Each identity grades twelve peer answers per epoch, with scores compared against the jury consensus. An ivory-tower grader that rubber-stamps everything drifts from consensus, and a deviation beyond fifteen points burns 40 POA from its grader bond. A bloc of fakes grading each other up gets caught together, since their onyx-dark, correlated scores burn the whole bloc's bonds at once. A thousand fake graders means posting 40,000 POA and keeping a thousand identities in lockstep, while honest graders risk nothing.
